name: pnpm

upstream_verification.method: npm registry ECDSA signature and SHA-512 integrity, retained in upstream installer
upstream_verification.sha256_note: This SHA-256 is locally pinned; upstream publishes the separate signed SHA-512 integrity value.

upstream_verification.method: npm registry ECDSA signature and SHA-512 integrity, retained in upstream installer
upstream_verification.sha256_note: This SHA-256 is locally pinned; upstream publishes the separate signed SHA-512 integrity value.

smoke: d=$(mktemp -d); cd "$d"; printf '{"name":"offline-smoke","scripts":{"smoke":"printf offline-pnpm-ok"}}\n' > package.json; result=$("$1/bin/pnpm" --silent run smoke); test "$result" = offline-pnpm-ok
notes: Retains npm registry signature verification and SHA-512 integrity verification. Packages include the platform executable and pnpm dist tree.
Pinned full version bypasses live latest lookup. PNPM_NO_MODIFY_PATH uses upstream supported option.

The upstream get.pnpm.io installer has no confirmed distribution license. This repository does not vendor its source; it is fetched at build time from a fixed commit and verified by SHA-256. Obtain upstream permission before publicly redistributing generated bundles containing that script.

validation_scope.userspace: Ubuntu 26.04.1 prepared image; unzip and OpenSSL available
validation_scope.runtime_scope: pnpm executable, dist tree and local script execution; external project dependencies not included
